description: qSOFA >= 2: RR >= 22/min, SBP <= 100 mm Hg, altered mentation (ACVPU other than A).
Any single NEWS parameter scoring 3: RR <=8 or >=25; SpO2 <=91; temp <=35.0; SBP <=90 or >=220; HR <=40 or >=131; consciousness V, P or U.

Aggregate NEWS (RCP 2012, Chart 1) >= 5 on a single Vitals item ('a medium score ... should prompt an urgent review'). Bands are [upper bound inclusive, score]; null upper = no bound. A null parameter scores 0, so the sum is a lower bound. New confusion (C) scores 0 under NEWS 2012 (NEWS2 is a D1 question).
Sudden face, arm or speech deficit (Face Arm Speech Test): a deficit term and a sudden-onset term in the same patient turn. Arm sensory terms (มือชา) are included for D1 review.
